about_short_description.short_description: Morada Uno empowers real estate brokers with tools and financial products to deliver digital, seamless and secure real estate services

product.name: Protección de Renta (Rent Protection)
product.description: A financial product that guarantees landlords receive rent payments up to 12 months even if tenants delay or default, including legal advice and tenant screening.

product.name: Investigación M1 (Tenant Screening)
product.description: A tenant background check service using over 30 national and international sources to evaluate tenant identity, credit, legal history, and payment capacity with results in 24 hours.

identifier.value: Elaboración y Firma de Contratos (Contract Preparation and Electronic Signing)

product.name: Elaboración y Firma de Contratos (Contract Preparation and Electronic Signing)
product.description: A service that prepares customized rental contracts and enables legally valid electronic signatures for landlords, tenants, and guarantors.

product.name: Seguro de Hogar (Home Insurance)
product.description: An insurance product that protects the property, landlord, tenant, and third parties against damages related to the rental property.

product.name: Servicios Legales (Legal Services)
product.description: Legal advisory and representation services covering contract drafting, dispute resolution, eviction processes, and property recovery for rental agreements.

product.name: Servicios de Compra-Venta (Purchase-Sale Services)
product.description: Services that analyze the legal status of properties and provide contract drafting and electronic signing for property purchase and sale transactions.
